entities.summary: Debby Stam-Pilon is a volleyball player from the Netherlands, who currently plays for French club Rocheville Le Cannet. While she began her career as a wing spiker, starting in 2015 Stam became a libero. She represented her country since 2004, winning the FIVB World Grand Prix 2007. In 2015, she played with the Dutch National Team at the 2015 European Games in Baku, Azerbaijan, and one year later attended the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
